description: Decreto nº 12.466, de 22 de maio de 2025 (raising IOF-Câmbio to 3.5% on FX outflows, cash and international cards; adjusted on 2025-05-23 by Decreto nº 12.467 restoring 1.1% on investment remittances and consolidated by Decreto nº 12.499 on 2025-06-11)
Decreto Legislativo nº 176/2025 suspending May-Jun 2025 IOF decrees and STF ADC 96 injunction by Min. Alexandre de Moraes (2025-07-04 suspension; 2025-07-16 prospective reinstatement of 3.5% IOF)

Resoluções BCB nº 519, 520 e 521, de 10 de novembro de 2025 (SPSAV licensing/governance framework and integration of cross-border virtual asset operations into the FX regulatory perimeter, amending Res. BCB 277/2022)
Ministério da Fazenda / Receita Federal draft decree proposal of 3.5% IOF on crypto/stablecoin purchases above R$ 10k/month (unenacted proposal under public debate)
Art. 4º of Resolução BCB nº 521/2025: mandatory BCB reporting and FX classification codes (Arts. 76-C, 82-A and Annex II-A of Res. BCB 277/2022) enter into force

BCB supervisory notification (ofício) to banks, FX brokers and investment fund administrators declaring virtual-asset FX import structures via investment funds irregular (reported by Isac Costa, ConJur 2026-07-01; confidential supervisory act, unconfirmed in public DOU)

Resolução BCB nº 561, de 30 de abril de 2026: overhauls eFX rules (Art. 50 of Res. BCB 277/2022), explicitly banning virtual assets/stablecoins as cross-border settlement rails between eFX providers and foreign counterparties

Resolução BCB nº 584, de 7 de agosto de 2026 (amending Res. BCB 142/2021): mandatory up to 24-hour precautionary hold (retenção cautelar) and COAF report on virtual asset transfers >= US$ 10,000 to foreign entities or self-hosted wallets (effective 2027-01-01; draft originally targeted Oct 2026)
Binance abrupt suspension of BRL deposits and withdrawals via Pix following Capitual termination (new partner Latam Gateway announced 2022-06-24; full Pix operations resumed 2022-07-06)
Binance global leverage cap (20x) and unverified account withdrawal cut (2 BTC to 0.06 BTC) amid CVM derivatives enforcement (preceding 2021-08-20 Brazilian futures shutdown)
CVM Colegiado approves R$ 9.6M Termo de Compromisso with Binance settling derivatives administrative proceeding (PAS CVM 19957.008369/2022-11; approved 2024-08-13, published in DOU 2024-08-20)
Binance tenfold reduction in USDT/BRL spot tick size from 0.001 to 0.0001 BRL (cutting minimum quote increment and bid-ask spread from ~8 bps to ~2 bps)

Foxbit-NovaDAX strategic client migration partnership (2026-07-07, following NovaDAX Brazil exit) alongside entry into force of Res. BCB 580 and Receita DeCripto IN RFB 2.291/2025 (2026-07-01), shifting institutional liquidity to domestic order books
